audit_only.rationale: Length-boundary and random-kept audit rows are otherwise technically eligible RNA/2F-RNA. Confirm the current route unless a separate scientific issue is visible. Audit only; do not reclassify solely because of boundary length.

known_motif.rationale: S2 detected a known shared-motif construct proposal. It has not been applied. Approve the existing motif trim, reject the trim and keep the full sequence, override with a numeric correction if appropriate, or defer. sequence_core is currently unchanged. Do not auto-approve.

sequence_notation.rationale: Source sequence notation is mixed T/U, ambiguous, gapped, or invalid. The proposed technical rejection is the governing default, but human review may determine whether a source notation or modification is recoverable. Do not automatically repair the sequence or erase explicit RDF molecule identity.

source_molecule_alphabet_conflict.rationale: RDF molecule type is DNA (canonical ssDNA) but the reported alphabet is a clean U/RNA alphabet. Remain parked as ssDNA. Do not automatically convert to RNA or overwrite RDF source type. CHECKPOINT-1 may later confirm DNA or authorise a reviewed molecule override.

molecule_type_unresolved.rationale: Aptamer-topic molecule_type is unknown. Do not infer RNA from a U-only alphabet or DNA from a T-only alphabet. Do not infer molecule type from label or modification text. Source review is required.

chemistry_requires_review.rationale: Molecule type is RNA but backbone/sugar chemistry is unsupported or unresolved (including Spiegelmer/L-RNA, 2NH2, 2OMe, mixed sugar/backbone, inverted-dT constructs, pentynyl-dU, iso-G, and other unusual modifications). Park for chemistry review. Do not flatten Spiegelmer/L-RNA to ordinary RNA chemistry.

judgement_dependent.rationale: Judgement-dependent technical, molecule, or chemistry condition. Do not treat this row as an automatic closed-vocabulary reject that can skip review.
